Lenovo Group Limited Revenue Records; AI Growth
: Lenovo Group (992) posted record FY revenue of $83.1B and Q1 FY26/27 revenue up 42% YoY. AI‑related sales rose 60%, citing progress on its AI roadmap.
Hybrid AI Plan Unveiled by Lenovo

: Lenovo Group (992) unveiled a Hybrid AI plan to embed AI across devices and services, aiming to link devices, data and workloads while stressing user-focused, privacy-first and efficient AI systems.
HSBC Cuts Lenovo Stake, Short Position Reduced
: HSBC cut its long stake in Lenovo (992) to 4.56% of shares outstanding from 5.34%, and reduced its short position to 4.08% from 4.86% as of Oct. 5.
Tech World @ CES 2027 Hosted by Lenovo
: Lenovo Group Limited (992) will host Tech World @ CES 2027 at the Sphere in Las Vegas on Jan 6, showcasing Hybrid AI demos across devices, infrastructure, software, solutions and services.
